## Claims
- [source-backed] The source states the lower-adjoined minimal generating set \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 219-235]
- [source-backed] The source gives the antipode formula \(S(s_\lambda)=(-1)^{|\lambda|}s_{\lambda'}\) and its Hopf-algebra identity. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 702-735]
- [source-backed] The inspected right-adjoined passage states only the set \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\}\), calls it the conjugate generating set, and says that one could transpose the arguments to prove its minimality. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 833-840]
- [unsupported] The inspected source does not state the requested signed equality in \(Q\):
  \[
  [\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}]=(-1)^{|\rho|}
  [\bar s_{(i+\rho'_1,\ldots,i+\rho'_b,i^{j-b})}].
  \]

## Strategy
Put \(q=n-r\), \(A=\Lambda/I_{r,q}\), \(A_+=\bigoplus_{d>0}A_d\), and \(Q=J_v/A_+J_v\). Assume
\[
a+j\le r,\qquad a+i\le q,\qquad b\le\min(i,j).
\]
For \(\rho\subseteq b^a\), pad \(\rho\) to \(a\) parts and set
\[
\rho'_k=\#\{\ell:\rho_\ell\ge k\}\quad(1\le k\le b).
\]
The intended equation is
\[
[\bar s_{L_\rho}]=(-1)^{|\rho|}[\bar s_{R_\rho}]\quad\text{in }Q,
\]
where
\[
L_\rho=(i^j,\rho),\qquad
R_\rho=(i+\rho'_1,\ldots,i+\rho'_b,i^{j-b}).
\]
Zero parts are omitted; in particular \(i^{j-b}\) is omitted if \(b=j\). Both shapes lie in \(q^r\).

For \(\rho=\varnothing\), and also for \(a=0\), both shapes equal \(i^j\), so the displayed equation is tautological.

The supplied source passage gives neither this equation nor a rectangular-straightening formula whose projection yields it. Its Hopf identity is an identity in \(\Lambda\), while the cited right-family passage supplies only a generating set and a proposed transposed proof. No source-backed derivation from full-coordinate row identities to the displayed equality in \(Q\) is present in the inspected material.

## Gaps
The requested source certificate is not established: no bounded supplied passage states the exact signed rectangular identity, and no checkable derivation of it from the accepted Hopf ingredient and graded-kernel presentation is supplied here.

## Next
A separate proof certificate would need an explicit integral rectangular-straightening identity, including all non-endpoint coefficients and their positive-degree containment in \(A_+J_v\).
